items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: they did a record like that with Joe Williams

ctx.x: I think Thad Jones-Mel Lewis, they did a record like that with Joe Williams, where they were up all night and they just went into the studio.

Yeah. Sometimes you get that momentum building up to that moment — rather than he’d go in, have breakfast, and everything’s calm and he said, “hello, good morning everybody,” and they all have had coffee, and the spirit is not there.
